label: DOC and Google begin Street View Trekker coverage of Great Walks
summary: Google announced the first New Zealand Trekker expedition with DOC, capturing 360-degree imagery on the Abel Tasman Coast and Heaphy tracks. DOC's 2014 annual report recorded the wider Google Maps recreation-data collaboration.

sources.label: Google New Zealand, Street View Trekker takes on the Abel Tasman and Heaphy Tracks, 18 August 2013
Department of Conservation, Annual Report for the year ended 30 June 2014, p. 76
